description: Takes one step in a journey started with journey_observe and returns the new observation. The extension refuses to submit a form, press a final button (pay, book, send, sign up, place an order) or sign in; a refused step comes back with stopped_by_policy and the reason. End every journey with a finish action. Needs the Chrome extension.

action.description: One step. click, type and select take a ref from the last observation; type also takes text (an obvious test value only) and select a value. navigate takes a URL, scroll a direction (up or down). finish ends the journey with its outcome: completed_read_only (the information was found), reached_confirmation (the final step was reached and not pressed), partial (progress, then a real failure) or blocked (no progress), and a note saying where and why.

name: journey_act
title: Act in an agent journey
